bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nTBILL is an issuer-native Nest BoringVault share deployed at the identical CREATE2 address 0xe72fe64840f4ef80e3ec73a1c749491b5c938cb9 on Ethereum, Plume, and Arbitrum. Row-level on-chain verification on 2026-07-20: Ethereum and Plume owner() both return the Nest admin contract 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a (the same uniform owner seen on the reviewed nWISDOM deployments), and Arbitrum owner() returns the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 that also owns the nTBILL Teller and Manager on Ethereum. Shares mint only through Nest's own Teller at vault NAV; no third-party bridge mints any deployment.

routes.reviewNote: On-chain reads 2026-07-20 (Ethereum block 25570877): owner() returned the Nest admin contract 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a (5450-byte contract; not a Safe — getThreshold/getOwners revert), the same uniform owner read on the reviewed nWISDOM Nest deployments. Cross-chain share movement runs through Nest's own vault rails (same uniform-owner pattern as the reviewed inALPHA/nWISDOM Nest deployments); shares mint only through Nest's own Teller contracts. Issuer-native deployment; no third-party bridge mints this deployment.
